title: Feature
description: A feature from a feature library

matchType.description: The match type of the feature. Used to determine how auto-annotate matches are made.

color.description: The color of the annotations generated by the feature. Must be a valid hex string

featureLibraryId.description: The id of the feature library the feature belongs to

featureType.description: The type of feature, like gene, promoter, etc. Note: This is an arbitrary string, not an enum

pattern.description: The pattern used for matching during auto-annotation.
